title: Shoemaker-Levy 9 breaks apart and strikes Jupiter
summary: Randall Carlson tells of Shoemaker-Levy 9 breaks apart and strikes Jupiter, about July 1994 at Jupiter, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So in I think the second week of July 1994, those 21 pieces impacted Jupiter.

plain: A researcher named Randall Carlson says that a comet called Shoemaker-Levy 9 broke apart into 21 pieces. He says those pieces struck the planet Jupiter in about the second week of July 1994, which he offers as proof that such impacts really happen in our solar system.
